exceptions.failureReason: Failed to parse invalid PDF object; broken xref/startxref and truncated object 565 0 stream/endobj near EOF.
notes: The repaired PDF is syntactically valid and analyzable by the scan pipeline.
The repaired copy lost pages relative to the original metadata-detected page count, so it is not a faithful full recovery.
Do not retry the original source in the normal scan loop unless a better source copy is found.
